$Comment: The Santa Suit, sold at Elsie the Weaver's Christmas stall. A one-use item: Secondary (Christmas_Santa_Suit_Wear) spends it and puts the thirty-minute costume Christmas_Costume_Santa on the player who used it; if the costume cannot go on (they already wear one, or a form they cannot take off), the table Christmas_Santa_Suit_Return hands the suit straight back. It wears the game's red wool bolt (Ingredient_Bolt_Wool's model with its red texture, and the red bolt's icon), so it never looks like a Christmas Present.
